interface.title: ProtoFold-Lab
interface.field: Computational structural biology / protein folding (coarse-grained modeling)
interface.stage_of_work: Early hypothesis generation, before heavier atomistic modeling or structure prediction
interface.what_it_is_for: Paste an amino-acid sequence, set the simulated-annealing options, and get a quick coarse-grained fold with a contact map, energy trajectory, per-residue table, and a stability/confidence summary.

data.note: The form comes pre-filled with the 40-residue demo sequence MKWVTFISLLFLFSSAYSRGVFRRDAHKSEVAHRFKDLGE. The page has no file input or example picker, so every other input was typed into the sequence box. To compare compositions I wrote my own sequences: a β-branched hydrophobic one (VIVTVYVIFTVKVIVTVEVYITVNGKTYTVIVEVKVYVTV), a charged E/K-rich 'regulatory' one (MSEEKKREEPSKDEGRKSPEQKKEDSPAKRESGEEKRKPG), a G/P/S/N-rich flexible one (GPSGNGSPGDGSPNGGSPGSGNPGDSGPGSNGPGSGPNGS), and the first 30 residues of the demo sequence. The bundled example sequences in examples/demo_sequences.fasta were not used in this run.

tree.general: Generate and judge a quick, cheap structural hypothesis for a candidate sequence before investing in expensive modeling
tree.specific: Run the Monte Carlo / simulated-annealing pseudo-backbone fold on an amino-acid sequence and read the fold, contact map, energy profile, stability score and fold bias

features.name: Bounded parameter form with live sequence filter and server-side validation
features.general: Enter an input and a few numeric run settings with enforced ranges; bad characters are dropped silently as you type, out-of-range numbers are blocked in the browser, and other bad input comes back with an error banner that keeps only the input text
features.specific: Sequence textarea plus number fields for steps (500–10000), temperature (0.5–5.0), cooling rate (0.990–0.9999) and an optional seed. The page upper-cases the sequence and silently drops non-standard letters (X, B, Z) and digits but lets line breaks through (static/js/app.js); HTML min/max blocks out-of-range numbers; the server rejects sequences under 8 residues, and internal line breaks with an 'invalid residue codes' error that names no visible code. After a 'Simulation error' banner only the sequence is re-filled: steps, temperature, cooling rate and seed return to defaults (app.py:421)
steps: Type or paste the sequence as one continuous line (no FASTA header)
Adjust steps, temperature and cooling rate (typing or arrow keys)
Optionally enter a seed
Submit; fix any out-of-range tooltip or error banner
After an error banner, re-enter the seed and any non-default settings before resubmitting
serves_tasks: Enter the input sequence and check that the tool accepts it
Set the search/optimisation parameters within allowed ranges

features.name: Seeded reproducible run with echoed configuration
features.general: Fix a random seed so a stochastic run can be repeated exactly, and print the settings used next to the result so it can be shared
features.specific: Random seed field; the Run configuration panel on the results page repeats steps, T0, cooling rate and seed, or 'randomized' when blank (the seed actually drawn is not shown, so unseeded runs cannot be reproduced). Seed 42 gave identical metrics twice
steps: Enter a seed and run
Note the Run configuration panel
Rerun with the same seed and compare the summary cards
Optionally leave the seed blank to see run-to-run spread
serves_tasks: Confirm a fixed seed reproduces the result exactly
See run-to-run variation without a fixed seed

features.name: Score summary cards with a confidence band and plain-language interpretation
features.general: Turn a run's raw outputs into a few headline numbers, a three-level confidence label and a sentence a non-specialist can read
features.specific: Six cards (residues, final energy, radius of gyration, stability score /100, contact density, confidence band: high / moderate / exploratory-low) plus the Interpretation snapshot (fold bias α / β / mixed-coil, hydrophobic core score, accepted move ratio, non-local contacts). The fold-bias label is counted from helix-, sheet- and breaker-forming residues in the sequence alone (app.py:246-256), so it ignores the simulated fold, steps and seed; that is why the G/P/S/N peptide is labelled β-enriched despite an extended chain
steps: Run a simulation
Read the headline cards and confidence band
Read the fold-bias label as a composition summary, and the interpretation sentence
Compare against another run
serves_tasks: Get the headline scores and an interpretation
Run inputs of contrasting composition, one at a time, under the same settings
Run a flexible, low-complexity input with a short search
Run a shorter fragment of the reference input

features.name: Projected chain geometry plus pairwise contact map
features.general: Show a 3D chain as a 2D projection coloured by a per-element property, next to a binary element-by-element proximity matrix, to judge compactness and long-range contacts
features.specific: Matplotlib PCA projection of the pseudo-backbone, coloured by residue hydropathy with labelled residue indices, beside an N×N residue contact map; static images with no hover or zoom, and the colour scale rescales per run
steps: Run a simulation
Scroll to Projected fold geometry and look for hydrophobic (red) residues grouping together
Read the contact map for far off-diagonal blocks (non-local contacts) versus mostly short-range contacts near the diagonal
Compare with another sequence's maps
serves_tasks: Judge whether the chain forms a compact core from its geometry and pairwise-contact pattern

features.name: Optimisation trajectory plot
features.general: Plot the objective value at every iteration of a stochastic optimiser to judge whether it has converged
features.specific: Energy vs Monte Carlo step line plot; the x-axis scales to the step count (2400 vs 8000), with a noisier early descent at higher starting temperature
steps: Run with one set of annealing settings
Look at where the energy curve flattens
Rerun with more steps, a different temperature or cooling rate and compare the curve and final energy
serves_tasks: Change optimisation settings and compare outcomes

features.name: Per-element feature table
features.general: List every element of the input with its intrinsic properties and a computed position measure
features.specific: Per-residue table: index, one-letter code, name, hydropathy, charge, radial distance from the centre of the fold, class (hydrophobic / polar-neutral / charged-polar); rows highlight on hover, no sorting or export
steps: Run a simulation
Scroll to Per-residue feature table
Scan radial distance against class to see which hydrophobic residues are buried
serves_tasks: Inspect per-element properties to find which parts are buried

features.name: Method explainer page
features.general: A page that states the model's representation, search method, energy terms, outputs and recommended next steps, so a user can judge how far to trust a result
features.specific: Method page (top nav): one pseudo-atom per residue, pivot moves, simulated annealing, energy terms (backbone-length restraint, steric exclusion, hydrophobic collapse, electrostatics, compactness), core outputs and recommended next steps
steps: Click Method in the top nav
Read the model description, energy terms and list of outputs
Read the recommended next steps
Click Simulation to return to the form
serves_tasks: Read how the model works and what it outputs
